description:
Currently 6 LDPC encoding doctests are marked no_run because they take 2-10 seconds each. These should be consolidated into a single comprehensive example or moved to integration tests to enable proper doctest validation.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Delivers “Consolidate expensive LDPC doctests into integration tests” with the behavior, scope, evidence, and constraints described above.


## Resolution

Subsumed by overhaul issues `a0a29512` (REQ-01, REQ-02) and `2596b143` (REQ-04): each Rustdoc example is removed under the example policy or retained compiling in the Rust CI doctest step.
title: Consolidate expensive LDPC doctests into integration tests
